ability.name: Rally Command
ability.description: Friendly units within 2 hexes gain +1 ATK and +1 DEF.

ability.name: Arcane Relay
ability.description: Teleports any single friendly unit anywhere within 6 hexes. Once per game turn.

ability.name: Instant Meditation
ability.description: Shrine meditation takes 0 turns instead of 1 (completes immediately on arrival).

ability.name: Ward Rune
ability.description: Places a permanent invisible rune on any hex. Enemy units entering take 3 damage. Rune is consumed on trigger.

ability.name: Snare
ability.description: Places a hidden snare on any hex within 3. Enemy unit entering the snare loses their entire next turn and cannot move.

ability.name: True Shot
ability.description: Arrows ignore all terrain cover bonuses. Can fire into forest hexes. Range 4. Only unit with this.

ability.name: Ambush
ability.description: Instantly defeats any non-specialty unit when attacking from invisibility (stealth > 0 and target unaware). Uses active spell slot.

ability.name: Stun Strike
ability.description: Target unit skips their entire next turn. Defeated units struck by Stun Strike CANNOT be reanimated by Necromancer. 3 uses.

ability.name: Grow Forest
ability.description: Permanently converts up to 3 adjacent plains or grasslands hexes to forest. Cannot convert mountain, ruins, or swamp. 2 uses.

ability.name: Reanimate
ability.description: Returns any defeated unit on an adjacent hex to life as a friendly allied unit for 5 turns. Returns with full base stats. Cannot reanimate units killed by Monk Stun Strike.

ability.name: Lightning Storm
ability.description: Deals 6 damage to ALL units in a 3-hex radius including friendlies. Area spell bonus applies (+1 damage = 7 total). T4 spell cost applies.

units.description: Fast naval fighter. Sea and port hexes only. Requires Sailing tech + Port structure.
Heavy naval combatant with cannon range. Sea and coastal hexes. Requires Sailing tech + Port.
Fast raider. High MOV. First-attack bonus. Requires Naval Supremacy tech.

pack_bonus.desc: Each additional goblin on the same hex adds +1 ATK to all goblins there.

berserk.desc: When below 50% HP, ATK increases by 2.

hunt.desc: If a unit it attacked last turn is still alive, Warg gets +2 MOV toward it next turn.

aerial.desc: Ignores forest, hills, mountain terrain costs. Cannot be slowed by terrain or entangle.

shroud.desc: Becomes invisible (Shroud) between attacks. Breaks on next attack.

undying.desc: At 0 HP, 30% chance to rise at 2 HP unless killed with Soulreaver or Holy spell.

petrifying_gaze.desc: On hit, target unit cannot act next turn (one-turn freeze). Applies before combat resolution.

regeneration.desc: +2 HP per turn. Suppressed if damaged by fire or acid this turn.

incorporeal.desc: Ignores ZoC entirely. Passes through occupied hexes without combat (unless choosing to attack). Unaffected by Traps.

spell_ward.desc: Reduces all incoming spell damage by 2.

breath_weapon.desc: On attack, adjacent units to the target also take 3 damage (splash).
